default.q: Where is St. Catharines and the Benchlands?
default.a: It's in the Niagara region of Ontario, on the wine-country 'bench' below the Niagara Escarpment. It's about a 1 hour 15 minute drive from Toronto. [PLACEHOLDER]

default.q: When is the best time to see fall colours?
default.a: Colour usually peaks from early to mid-October, but the season runs from late September into November. [PLACEHOLDER]
